scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the next five Expo originals. Not executions or permanent exclusions.
linked_reference_caveat: Only these five complete originals were read. Detailed references, installed SDK and command versions, actual project inputs, native artifacts and licenses require separate review. No external service, install, simulator or submission was run.

sources.workflow: Select the actual native or React Native project path, configure the appropriate EAS release profiles, build the requested app, submit to the intended store or testing track, and report the furthest actually verified build, processing and availability state. Preserve existing project and store identity rather than recreating it.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real compatible app project, selected platform, version-compatible CLI, linked EAS project and appropriate build resources are needed. Real signing and store submission require the relevant accounts, memberships, credentials and approved destination. Native-only projects have different source-of-truth and archive checks from Expo projects. The linked platform, processing, metadata and workflow references define exact acceptance gates and require separate review.
sources.offline_assessment: A separately selected release-config or archive-inspection task could be offline using an unchanged public app or artifact and the actual local schema and tooling. The default isolated Python runtime cannot build native apps or use EAS or stores. A generated configuration, queued submission or successful cloud build is not Apple acceptance, tester access or an available release. No live account or credentials were accessed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Bind app and configuration hashes, exact bundle and package identities, actual archive versions, build and submission IDs to the requested track and verified processing state. Inspect archived native version fields rather than assuming a remote counter was used. Keep build, queued submission, accepted processing, tester availability and public release as distinct outcomes.

sources.workflow: Select the actual app instrumentation, recorded-metrics query, metric interpretation or library integration task and use the matching reference. Respect version-specific root components, interactive markers, navigation metrics and event interfaces rather than applying one SDK's surface to every project.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual app and SDK, compatible native Observe library and development or production build are required for runtime instrumentation; the library is not in Expo Go. Real EAS metric queries need an appropriate authenticated project and retained service data. Canonical docs and actual installed packages or command help resolve the listed known documentation gaps. The original does not require querying a live service merely to edit local integration code.
sources.offline_assessment: Code-only instrumentation or interpretation of an unchanged public captured metrics export could be offline after reviewing exact types, references and input provenance. The default Python container lacks the native app runtime and service observations. A hook call or source diff alone does not establish emitted startup measurements, crash reporting or improved user performance.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the installed version and selected interface with the saved app changes, native build and actual events or metrics requested. Reconcile aliases, units, route and session identity, sample configuration and collection environment. Distinguish an exported error-reporting symbol from actual crash reporting and a plausible diagnosis from a measured before-and-after improvement.

sources.workflow: Choose the actual requested remote simulator mode, verify account availability and project identity, create or explicitly reuse an owned ready session, install a fresh build of the correct static or development type, drive the actual app using supported controller observations, retain visual evidence and stop owned one-shot resources or honor an explicitly requested bounded live preview.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authorized EAS access and feature availability, a linked real app project, supported current CLI and controller, correct build artifact and connection metadata are required. Development iteration additionally needs an actual development client and approved live development transport. A cloud simulator is distinct from a local emulator or physical device. Detailed mode, controller and recovery references require separate review. Session tokens are secrets, not public evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: The required remote hosted simulator and live app-control path cannot run in the default network-isolated Python executor. A static screenshot, fabricated accessibility tree or local mock session is not the selected remote app run. Local analysis of an authentic public recording could be separately selected work, but would not create or control a device. Native-device claims must not be inferred from a hosted emulator either.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Bind the exact current app fingerprint and build type to actual named session identity, live readiness, controller actions, downloaded captures and final owned-resource state. Verify real reload for development mode, distinguish user preview from app deep links, and use actual video for motion rather than a still. Preserve requested duration and honest recording frame-rate limits without claiming sub-frame timing or hardware validation.

sources.workflow: Write or edit the actual project's EAS workflow using authoritative current schema, syntax and prepackaged-job references, check required fields and dependency and expression references, and run the actual authoritative EAS validation for each changed workflow.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual project, workflow request, schema and syntax references, fetch helper and matching CLI are required. Full validation explicitly needs a logged-in linked project and server-side EAS checks, including build profiles from the actual configuration. Triggering real workflow jobs is a distinct action with its own compute and store requirements, not necessary merely to draft YAML. The exact schema and helper need separate review.
sources.offline_assessment: A separately labeled schema-only authoring task could be offline with a pinned real schema, unchanged public project and reviewed parser. This does not satisfy the original's explicit authoritative server-side validation gate. The default Python runtime cannot authenticate or contact EAS, and a local YAML parse cannot replace the named CLI validator or prove a build pipeline ran.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual saved workflow location and size, field and job enums, existing profile names, valid dependency graph and expression contexts against the correct schema. For the original full gate retain actual CLI identity, input hashes and server-validated result. Keep syntax validity, authorized server validation and successful CI execution separate rather than crediting one as all three.

sources.workflow: Determine whether the requested mobile interaction should animate, select its purpose and lowest-complexity supported native or Reanimated mechanism, implement the actual motion, gesture handoff and appropriate haptic and reduced-motion behavior, and name the real-device release checks needed to judge feel and performance.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real compatible Expo or React Native project, the selected installed animation, gesture or navigation packages and correct runtime configuration are required. Reanimated version and architecture constrain worklets and easing APIs. Matching recipes require review. The source explicitly reserves verified feel for a release build on the slowest supported physical device rather than Expo Go, a simulator or code inspection. Not every request needs every listed package or any animation at all.
sources.offline_assessment: A source-only implementation or bounded static or unit test can be offline in a reviewed compatible app toolchain. The default standard-library Python executor cannot run native motion or establish physical-device gesture, timing or haptic quality. Mock shared values and a screenshot cannot complete the source's release-device verification claim. A documented no-animation decision is not an implemented motion sequence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the concrete interaction and frequency gate with the actual code, installed APIs, UI-thread behavior, properties, timing and interruption logic. Check reduced-motion and large-text behavior and appropriate nonexclusive feedback. Any runtime or performance claim needs actual release-build device evidence under the declared support conditions, including motion capture or measurements appropriate to the claim, not only passing source checks.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
